title: Which Way to the Station?
label: ch:sa-which-way-to-the-station
canDo: I can ask the way (sthānakaṃ kutra asti? kathaṃ gacchāmi? kiyat dūram?) and follow the answer: left, right, straight on (vāmataḥ, dakṣiṇataḥ, ṛju gacchatu).

payoff.summary: Complete SA-R280-asking-the-way: ask the way and follow the answer.
